newsitem.title: USA: No damaging cold seen for Brazil coffee areas- WSC.
newsitem.headline: No damaging cold seen for Brazil coffee areas- WSC.

text.p: Temperatures in Brazil's coffee-growing areas will be below normal through Sunday, though damaging cold is not expected, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp (WSC) said on Friday.
WSC said low temperatures in central Brazil would fall to 40-52 F on Sunday morning, but conditions would be fair with moderating temperatures from Sunday through to Tuesday.
It forecast mostly sunny weather on Friday with highs of 66-77 F and a mostly clear and cool night with lows of 45-55 F.
Saturday would again be sunny, with highs of 66-77 F.
The region saw isolated showers of 0.15-0.65 inch on Thursday and highs of 64-77 F.
WSC said conditions for trees and the maturing crop remained generally favourable.
